**Finding submitted: deviation (§ 7.2, p0026).**

- **Issue:** § 7.2 is a reverse MFN burdening us — Customer must disclose *and match* for Vendor any more favourable third-party commercial offer, with no product scope, duration cap, or comparison carve-outs. That is the playbook walk-away position.
- **Inconsistency:** It directly contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no most-favoured-customer commitment.
- **No offsetting benefit:** A document-wide search found no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour, so nothing worth preserving.
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** delete p0026 in full; fallback (defined product, 12 months, reasonable-comparison carve-outs) offered in the comment. Note the duplicate 7.2 numbering — the invoicing clause at sec-7.2-2 is untouched.
